name: Wei Jian Tan
bio:
Wei Jian Tan’s path to motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After graduating with a business degree, he initially worked in the corporate sector, but a chance visit to the Singapore Grand Prix ignited a passion for racing. He quickly realized his organizational skills and understanding of people could be invaluable in the high-pressure environment of motorsport. He transitioned into HR roles within smaller racing teams, honing his abilities in recruitment, talent management, and conflict resolution. 

At Triple Eight Race Engineering, Wei Jian focuses on building a cohesive and highly motivated team. He believes in fostering a transparent and supportive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. His pragmatic approach ensures that HR policies are not only compliant but also contribute directly to the team's performance and success on the track. He’s known for his ability to mediate effectively between different departments and personality types, always striving for practical solutions that benefit the team as a whole.

 Wei Jian is particularly dedicated to promoting diversity within the team, aiming to create opportunities for talented individuals from all backgrounds. He's an active member of several motorsport industry groups focused on improving inclusivity and developing future generations of racing professionals. He’s also a certified mediator, a skill that proves useful more often than one might expect in the fast-paced world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part
physical.description: Wei Jian is of average height with a lean build and a calm, approachable demeanor.
